description: Postman requests that exercise a scenario on an endpoint the SDK already covers, rather than a distinct operation. The generator maps each to the canonical request's method instead of minting a new one, so a contract-test case cannot become permanent public API surface. Adding an entry here removes nothing that already exists; it only prevents a new method being generated.

fleetbase-api-trailers-attach-device-to-.rationale: Attaches an existing device to a trailer through the Device API.

fleetbase-api-trailers-attach-equipment-.rationale: Attaches equipment to a trailer through the Equipment API.

fleetbase-api-trailers-create-trailer-de.rationale: Creates a device fixture through the Device API.

fleetbase-api-trailers-create-trailer-eq.rationale: Creates an equipment fixture through the Equipment API.

fleetbase-api-trailers-delete-trailer-de.rationale: Cleans up the device fixture through the Device API.

fleetbase-api-trailers-delete-trailer-eq.rationale: Cleans up the equipment fixture through the Equipment API.

fleetbase-api-trailers-detach-trailer-at.rationale: Detaches the trailer's device through the Device API.

fleetbase-api-trailers-detach-trailer-eq.rationale: Detaches the trailer's equipment through the Equipment API.

fleetbase-api-trailers-reattach-equipmen.rationale: Exercises moving equipment between attachments using the same attach operation.

fleetbase-api-trailers-verify-detached-c.rationale: Queries connection history after detaching using the same history operation.

fleetbase-api-trailers-verify-trailer-eq.rationale: Retrieves the trailer to verify its equipment representation.

fleetbase-api-fleets-reassign-a-driver-t.rationale: Assigns the same driver twice to prove membership assignment is idempotent. Same route and same call.

fleetbase-api-fleets-reassign-a-vehicle-.rationale: Assigns the same vehicle twice to prove membership assignment is idempotent. Same route and same call.

fleetbase-api-fleets-remove-a-driver-fro.rationale: Removes an already-removed driver to prove the delete is idempotent. Same route and same call.

fleetbase-api-fleets-remove-a-vehicle-fr.rationale: Removes an already-removed vehicle to prove the delete is idempotent. Same route and same call.

fleetbase-api-fleets-create-a-fleet-driv.rationale: Creates the driver the fleet membership requests operate on. It posts to /drivers, so it belongs to DriverService::createDriver rather than a FleetService method that does not touch /fleets.

fleetbase-api-fleets-create-a-fleet-vehi.rationale: Creates the vehicle the fleet membership requests operate on. It posts to /vehicles, so it belongs to VehicleService::createVehicle.

fleetbase-api-fleets-delete-a-fleet-driv.rationale: Cleans up the driver fixture. It deletes from /drivers, so it belongs to DriverService::deleteDriver.

fleetbase-api-fleets-delete-a-fleet-vehi.rationale: Cleans up the vehicle fixture. It deletes from /vehicles, so it belongs to VehicleService::deleteVehicle.

fleetbase-api-fleets-create-a-subfleet.rationale: Creates a fleet with a parent_fleet set. A subfleet is a fleet, created by the same POST /fleets call.

fleetbase-api-fleets-delete-a-subfleet.rationale: Deletes the subfleet fixture through the same DELETE /fleets/:id call.

fleetbase-api-drivers-create-an-operatio.rationale: Creates a driver without an email or phone to prove those are optional. Same POST /drivers call with a narrower body.

fleetbase-api-drivers-delete-an-operatio.rationale: Cleans up the operational driver fixture through the same DELETE /drivers/:id call.

fleetbase-api-drivers-update-a-driver-un.rationale: Resubmits a driver's existing email and phone to prove uniqueness does not reject a record against itself. Same PUT /drivers/:id call.

fleetbase-api-vehicles-expand-a-vehicle.rationale: Retrieves a vehicle with ?with[]= expansion. Expansion is a query parameter on GET /vehicles/:id, not a separate operation.

fleetbase-api-vehicles-expand-a-vehicle-.rationale: The scalar ?with= form of the same expansion on GET /vehicles/:id.

fleetbase-api-orders-create-an-order-wit.rationale: Creates an order sending driver and vehicle as empty strings, to prove an empty relationship is ignored rather than rejected. Same POST /orders call.

fleetbase-api-service-rates-create-a-ser.rationale: Creates a service rate sending service_area and zone as empty strings, to prove an empty optional relationship is not a validation error. Same POST /service-rates call.
